notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary interaction send/receive delivery across active and passive subscriptions. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and federation identity. It verifies standard interaction and parameter identity, payload, tag, producer, transportation, invalid-class rejection, active/passive subscription eligibility, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador interaction-class and parameter lookup, publication, subscription, ordinary interaction send, resignation, and federation teardown services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction callback
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador ordinary interaction declarations and FederateAmbassador interaction callback
